description: Reads events and the current revision of a selected feed for a requested schedule lookup or revision. include_facets=true provides known facet values for label selection. Facets describe the entire published active feed, independent of read filters or pagination. Nonempty filters also return filtered_subscription with canonical filters, matching_event_count and unmatched_filter_values. Its nested URLs address that selection; top-level subscription URLs remain unfiltered. Event IDs, external keys, dates, removal state and pagination narrow only the read, never the subscription. Filtering changes no events and creates no cloned feed. A complete unfiltered read is a prerequisite for assessing cancellations from a revised schedule; omission from a filtered or paginated result is not evidence of deletion. Scope is limited to the connected account’s Smart Calendars AI feeds. No mailbox access, source-document retrieval, automatic source monitoring, scheduled PDF checks or document refresh is provided. Structured schedule content is supplied explicitly by the caller. Result links: subscription_open_url is the exact HTTPS handoff to the default calendar app via webcal; subscription_options_url provides Apple/default, Google, Outlook and copy-link choices; subscription_url is the copyable HTTPS calendar-file fallback; manage_url opens the feed dashboard. URL hosts, paths and tokens identify the returned resource and are not interchangeable. A filtered_subscription has its own links for that selection; top-level links remain unfiltered. Subscription access requires distribution_ready=true. Opening a link does not confirm a subscription; confirmation occurs in the user’s calendar app. Filter privacy: filters select events, not who can access them; anyone with the link can remove the filters and read the full published calendar.

event_ids.description: Optional selection of up to 250 existing event IDs. Omitted or empty means no event-ID restriction. This narrows only the read.

external_keys.description: Optional selection of up to 250 source-stable external keys. Omitted or empty means no external-key restriction. Combined with other read filters.

feed_id.description: Identity of the selected calendar returned in feed results.

filters.description: Values identify known labels from available_facets; include_facets=true provides that vocabulary. Values are trimmed and case-insensitive; format accepts attendance-mode aliases. Values within a field use OR; different fields use AND. Unknown values never broaden the selection. Filtering cannot infer missing metadata.

city.description: An existing event-city facet selected from available_facets.city, not the user’s current city or residence. User geolocation is outside this field’s scope.

country.description: An existing event-country facet selected from available_facets.country, not the user’s nationality or residence. User geolocation is outside this field’s scope.

format.description: Existing attendance-mode labels from available_facets.format, such as online or in-person; accepted aliases are normalized by the server.

person.description: An event participant or organizer from available_facets.person, not an account or profile lookup.

source.description: Child-feed/source identifier from available_facets.source, not a source URL.

topic.description: Existing topic or category labels from available_facets.topic.

venue.description: An event venue selected from available_facets.venue, not a user-location lookup.

from.description: Inclusive lower date bound in YYYY-MM-DD format. Events whose date span overlaps the requested range can match; omission leaves the lower bound open.

include_facets.description: Includes available_facets ({value,label,count} entries), facet_coverage ({tagged_events,fallback_events,missing_events}), facets_truncated and facet_scope=published_active_events. Coverage distinguishes explicit tags, fallbacks and missing values; title/location fallbacks do not infer classifications or audiences. Nonempty filters also include these results. Canonical fields: person, venue, topic, city, country, format, source.

limit.description: Maximum events returned on this page, from 1 to 250; defaults to 100.

offset.description: Number of matching results skipped before this page; defaults to 0. The response next_offset identifies the next page when present.

removal_state.description: Event cancellation state to return: active excludes canceled events, removed returns canceled events, and all includes both. Defaults to active.

to.description: Inclusive upper date bound in YYYY-MM-DD format. Events whose date span overlaps the requested range can match; omission leaves the upper bound open.

name: get_feed
title: Read calendar events
